normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents… "1660 #302", a beautifully appointed 1-bedroom condo in the heart of WaterColor. Boasting panoramic views from a spacious private balcony, this serene escape is just a 1-minute walk to the Beach Club and beach access. Explore nearby shops and dining moments away, or unwind at one of the many resort pools, easily accessible with the beach bikes provided. Perfect for couples seeking a peaceful and luxurious 30A getaway.*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Large Private Balcony: Enjoy serene vistas from your private balconyPrime Location: Just a 1-2 minute walk to the Beach Club, beach access, shopping, and diningResort Amenities: Access to multiple pools, including the WaterColor Beach ClubBeach Bikes: Includes 2 adult bikes for exploring the areaFully Equipped Kitchen: Stainless steel appliances and granite countertops for all your culinary needsSpacious Primary Suite: King-size bed with en-suite bathroom and private sundeck for ultimate relaxationEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"Absolutely stunning rental with all the necessities closely at hand. We would stay here again, and again, and again…you get the idea. 30A Escapes sealed the deal by making the entire experience a dream." – Melissa L.⭐"Wonderful stay! I'm not typically one to write reviews; however, our experience was such a wonderful one that I had to write about it. We loved everything about the condo—location, cleanliness, modern furnishings, and property amenities." – Leslie S.⭐"Perfect WaterColor location! Walking distance to the Beach Club made trips to the beach so easy! Communication was top-notch. Can’t wait to come back!" – Natalie C.*** YOUR 30A BEACH ESCAPE ***Welcome to “1660 #302”, a charming condo perfectly situated in WaterColor Resort. With panoramic views, a private balcony, and proximity to the Beach Club and beach access, this retreat offers both comfort and convenience. Explore the vibrant community with beach bikes, relax by the resort pools, or unwind in the spacious Primary Suite—your ideal 30A escape awaits.*** LIVING AREA ***Open Concept: Bright living area with comfortable seating and serene top floor viewsEntertainment: Flat-screen TV for your viewing pleasureBalcony Access: Step out to the private balcony with outdoor seating*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Fully Equipped Kitchen: Stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and all essentials for meal preparationDining Area: Table with seating for four, plus additional bar seating*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Primary Suite - 2nd Floor: King-size bed, en-suite bathroom with enclosed glass shower, double vanity, and access to a private sundeck with lounge chairsAdditional Full Bathroom - 1st Floor: With shower/tub combination and single vanity*** OUTDOOR & OTHER AMENITIES ***Private Balcony: Outdoor seating with serene top-floor viewsSundeck: Lounge chairs for sunbathingBeach Bikes: Explore the resort and 30A*** WATERCOLOR RESORT AMENITIES ***Private Beach Club: Gulf-view dining, poolside service, and towel amenitiesOn-Site Spa: Luxurious treatments availableTennis Facility: Courts with a professional Pro ShopFitness & Adventure: RUN/SUP workouts at Western LakeBoutique Shopping & Dining: Shops and Fish Out of Water restaurantScenic Trails: Miles of biking and walking pathsWaterColor Resort Pools:The Beach Club Pool (Park District)The Boathouse Pool (Park District)Camp WaterColor (Camp District): Lazy river and slidesFrog Pool (Lake District)Dragonfly Pool (Crossings District)*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***WaterColor Beach Club: Dining, pools, and beach access within a minute’s walkShopping & Dining: Steps from boutique shops and local restaurantsWestern Lake: Paddleboard or kayak on this rare coastal dune lakeScenic Trails: Miles of picturesque biking and walking paths*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 2 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.The HOA does not provide an area for guests to charge their LSVs even in common areas. Therefore, any rented LSVs should be gas-powered*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 210786
